understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'. When multiple goals existed, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to report WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved one grid cell, equal to 3 pixels, in the selected direction. Movement could be blocked or affected by walls and pushable blocks; heuristic blocked indicators were not always definitive, so actions had to be tested. Multiple selectable pieces could be controlled by using CLICK with their pixel-coordinate positions.
